svg.text: Cloth statics: can one Gauss-Seidel sweep per substep carry a static load across a stiff sheet?
Sheet 3 m wide by 8 m high hung from its top row, 1 kN on the bottom row. Stretch after 6 s settle, as a percentage of the converged XPBD answer (200 iterations per substep).
Stretch relative to converged, one sweep per substep
substeps per 60 Hz tick (substep rate 60 to 3840 Hz)
True Wind's report: 2 to 100 times too stretchy
